text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.efo_term. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. drug_indication.mesh_heading = 'Prostatic Neoplasms' OR drug_indication.efo_term LIKE '%prostate cancer%'.
